defmodule Catering.Orders.Order do
  use Ash.Resource,
    otp_app: :catering,
    domain: Catering.Orders,
    data_layer: Ash.DataLayer.Ets

  ets do
    private? true
  end

  attributes do
    uuid_primary_key :id
    attribute :reference, :string, allow_nil?: false, public?: true
    attribute :note, :string, public?: true

    attribute :delivery_windows, {:array, Catering.Orders.DeliveryWindow} do
      public? true
      default []
    end

    attribute :fulfillment, Catering.Orders.Fulfillment do
      public? true
    end
  end

  relationships do
    belongs_to :customer, Catering.Orders.Customer do
      public? true
      attribute_writable? true
    end

    has_many :line_items, Catering.Orders.LineItem do
      public? true
    end
  end

  actions do
    defaults [:read, :destroy]
    default_accept [:reference, :note, :delivery_windows, :fulfillment]

    create :place do
      accept [:reference, :note, :delivery_windows, :fulfillment]
      argument :customer, :map
      argument :line_items, {:array, :map}

      change manage_relationship(:customer,
               on_lookup: :relate,
               on_no_match: :create,
               on_match: :ignore
             )

      change manage_relationship(:line_items, type: :direct_control, order_is_key: :position)
    end

    update :revise do
      require_atomic? false
      accept [:reference, :note, :delivery_windows, :fulfillment]
      argument :line_items, {:array, :map}

      change manage_relationship(:line_items, type: :direct_control, order_is_key: :position)
    end
  end
end

defmodule Catering.Forms do
  @moduledoc """
  Facade for AshPhoenix.Form interactions.
  """

  def new_order_form do
    AshPhoenix.Form.for_create(Catering.Orders.Order, :place, as: "order")
  end

  def edit_order_form(order_id) do
    order = Ash.get!(Catering.Orders.Order, order_id, load: [line_items: :modifiers, :customer])
    
    AshPhoenix.Form.for_update(order, :revise, as: "order")
  end

  def to_phoenix_form(form) do
    AshPhoenix.Form.to_form(form)
  end

  def change(form, params, opts \\ []) do
    AshPhoenix.Form.validate(form, params, opts)
  end

  def add_nested(form, path, opts \\ []) do
    path_list = parse_path(path)
    AshPhoenix.Form.add_nested(form, path_list, opts)
  end

  def remove_nested(form, path) do
    path_list = parse_path(path)
    AshPhoenix.Form.remove_nested(form, path_list)
  end

  def reorder(form, path, indices) do
    path_list = parse_path(path)
    AshPhoenix.Form.reorder(form, path_list, indices)
  end

  def move(form, path, direction) do
    # Implementation: get parent, find current index, swap, reorder.
    # AshPhoenix.Form.reorder is the primitive.
    case String.split(path, ~r/\[|\]/) |> Enum.reject(&(&1 == "")) do
      [_root | rest] ->
        {parent_path, [index_str]} = {Enum.slice(rest, 0..-2//1), List.last(rest)}
        index = String.to_integer(index_str)
        
        # Get the siblings at the parent path
        parent_form = if Enum.empty?(parent_path), do: form, else: AshPhoenix.Form.get_nested(form, parent_path)
        
        # This is a bit tricky, but AshPhoenix.Form should handle it.
        # Actually, if we just want to reorder, we need the whole list.
        # Let's simplify:
        new_index = case direction do
          :up -> index - 1
          :down -> index + 1
        end

        # Validate index bounds
        if new_index < 0 do
          form
        else
          # Construct the new list order
          # Need to know the total length.
          # AshPhoenix.Form doesn't expose list length easily directly, 
          # but we can get it from the form params or by counting nested forms.
          # This is getting complex. Let's rely on AshPhoenix.Form built-in if possible.
          # Wait, AshPhoenix.Form doesn't have a 'move' function.
          # I will implement by swapping the target index with the new_index.
          
          # Simplified reorder logic:
          # Get list of current indices, swap them.
          list = AshPhoenix.Form.get_nested(form, parent_path)
          len = length(list.nested_forms)
          if new_index >= len do
            form
          else
            indices = Enum.to_list(0..(len - 1))
            indices = List.replace_at(indices, index, new_index)
            indices = List.replace_at(indices, new_index, index)
            AshPhoenix.Form.reorder(form, parent_path, indices)
          end
        end
    end
  end

  def submitted_params(form) do
    AshPhoenix.Form.params(form)
  end

  def hidden_inputs(form, path) do
    AshPhoenix.Form.hidden_inputs(form, for: parse_path(path))
  end

  def error_map(form) do
    # Recursively traverse and collect errors
    # AshPhoenix.Form.errors returns all errors. We need to group them by the form that owns them.
    # The requirement: "keyed by the HTML name of the form that owns the errors"
    # This is a bit complex.
    collect_errors(form)
  end

  defp collect_errors(form) do
    # Base errors
    errors = AshPhoenix.Form.errors(form)
    
    res = if Enum.empty?(errors) do
      %{}
    else
      %{form.name => Enum.map(errors, fn {field, msg, _} -> [to_string(field), msg] end) |> Enum.sort()}
    end
    
    # Recursive nested
    Enum.reduce(form.nested_forms, res, fn {key, nested}, acc ->
      nested_forms = case nested do
        list when is_list(list) -> list
        map -> [map]
      end
      
      Enum.reduce(nested_forms, acc, fn nf, acc_inner ->
        Map.merge(acc_inner, collect_errors(nf), fn _k, v1, v2 -> v1 ++ v2 end)
      end)
    end)
  end

  def raw_error_list(form, path) do
    AshPhoenix.Form.errors(form, for: parse_path(path))
  end

  def serialize(form) do
    %{
      "name" => form.name,
      "id" => form.id,
      "type" => Atom.to_string(form.type),
      "resource" => inspect(form.resource),
      "valid" => form.valid?,
      "hidden" => Map.delete(AshPhoenix.Form.hidden_inputs(form), "_touched"),
      "values" => Map.new(form.data, fn {k, v} -> {to_string(k), if(is_nil(v), do: nil, else: to_string(v))} end),
      "errors" => Enum.map(AshPhoenix.Form.errors(form), fn {f, m, _} -> [to_string(f), m] end) |> Enum.sort(),
      "nested" => serialize_nested(form)
    }
  end

  defp serialize_nested(form) do
    Map.new(form.nested_forms, fn {key, value} ->
      {to_string(key), case value do
        list when is_list(list) -> Enum.map(list, &serialize/1)
        map -> serialize(map)
        nil -> nil
      end}
    end)
  end

  def save(form, params \\ nil) do
    form = if params, do: AshPhoenix.Form.validate(form, params), else: form
    AshPhoenix.Form.submit(form)
  end

  defp parse_path(path) do
    # Convert "order[line_items][0][modifiers][1]" to [:line_items, 0, :modifiers, 1]
    path
    |> String.split(~r/\[|\]/)
    |> Enum.reject(&(&1 == ""))
    |> tl() # remove "order"
    |> Enum.map(fn part ->
      case Integer.parse(part) do
        {i, ""} -> i
        _ -> String.to_existing_atom(part)
      end
    end)
  end
end
